messages:
maya: Quick sync  mini webinar tomorrow. Need X teaser + LinkedIn long-thread + 30s clip. Who owns copy + asset QA?
leah: I can do copy + first-pass captions. Need MP4 clip, thumbnail (16:9), transcript, headshots.
omar: Ops will export clip + transcript by 10:00 PT. @sasha can you deliver thumbnails + a short GIF by 11:00?
sasha: Yep. I'll make 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 thumbs + a 12s GIF. PNG + MP4. Use the new launch palette.
maya: Proposed schedule: X teaser 09:00 PT, LinkedIn thread 12:00 PT, clip follow-up +24h. Approval cutoff 08:30 PT.
leah: Messaging call: benchmark stat vs customer story? Benchmarks drive CTR but legal could delay. Suggest anonymized stat backup ("~2x cost reduction").
omar: CRM routing: tag signups "miniweb-apr"; utm_source=social_x / social_li. SDRs get Slack + email pings. Ops confirmed.
leah: Engagement plan: reply to top 5 comments within 1h, amplify best into a quote post. I'll own first 45m replies then hand to community.
sasha: I'll design LinkedIn hero with a placeholder stat so we can swap copy without redesign.
queue-bot: Drafts queued: X teaser (09:00 PT), LinkedIn thread (12:00 PT). Will publish automatically if approvals present by 08:30 PT.
maya: Approval flow: leah -> sasha -> legal (only if numbers). If legal not back by 08:30, remove hard numbers and proceed. Post-launch: track CTR, signups, CPL. 15m postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT to iterate messaging.
